**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 18:50  
[FACT] User is promoting freelance writing services on social media.  
[CHANGE] User has been focusing on promoting freelance writing services for the past three months.  
[EVENT] User has seen a significant surge in engagement on their Twitter account.  
[FACT] User has an average of 20 new followers per day on Twitter.  
[PREFERENCE] User has noticed that their Instagram account has been performing well, with an average engagement rate of 5%.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tracking engagement rates on Twitter and Instagram can help understand content resonance, identify areas for improvement, and optimize social media strategy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Twitter engagement is measured through likes, retweets, replies, and quote tweets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Engagement Rate formula for Twitter: Engagement Rate = (Total Engagements / Total Impressions) x 100.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Total Engagements for Twitter = Likes + Retweets + Replies + Quote Tweets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Total Impressions for Twitter = Number of times your tweet was viewed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Twitter Analytics can be accessed by logging into the Twitter account, clicking on the profile picture, selecting "Twitter Analytics," and viewing tweet-level metrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instagram engagement is measured through likes, comments, saves, and shares.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Engagement Rate formula for Instagram: Engagement Rate = (Total Engagements / Total Reach) x 100.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Total Engagements for Instagram = Likes + Comments + Saves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Total Reach for Instagram = Number of unique accounts that viewed the post.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instagram Insights can be accessed by ensuring the account is a business profile, tapping the three horizontal lines on the profile page, and selecting "Insights."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for tracking engagement rates include tracking regularly, comparing to industry benchmarks, experimenting with content types, engaging with the audience, and using hashtags strategically.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For Instagram Stories, use the "Swipe-Up" feature, create engaging content, ask questions and polls, utilize "Story Highlights," post consistently, and monitor story metrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For IGTV, create long-form content, optimize titles and descriptions, use catchy thumbnails, promote IGTV content, engage with the audience, and maintain consistency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for Instagram include cross-promoting, timing content strategically, being authentic, and collaborating with other creators.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User is thinking of experimenting with Instagram Stories
